identitySignals: Agenda names 'Hadar Institute (Pedagogy of Partnership)' in New York, NY; hadar.org (site named 'Hadar Institute', 210 W 93rd St, New York, NY) runs a program called 'Pedagogy of Partnership', a unique name pairing that matches the agenda text

The IRS-registered nonprofit 'Mechon Hadar' (EIN 26-4412164, New York, NY, ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer) is the earlier name of the organization; hadar.org publishes 'Mechon Hadar' news under the Hadar Institute name
Pedagogy of Partnership trains teachers and school leaders in partner-based learning (havruta), consistent with OUSD's 'Classroom & academic programs' / teacher quality (Title II-A) contracts
Hadar's Pedagogy of Partnership school-partner list includes Oakland Hebrew Day School (Oakland, CA), showing work in the Oakland area, though no page found names OUSD
research.notes: Legal (IRS) name is 'Mechon Hadar'; the organization now operates as 'Hadar Institute'. The link between the two names rests on hadar.org itself publishing 'Mechon Hadar' announcements under the Hadar Institute name; no page found explicitly says 'formerly Mechon Hadar'. No public page found that names OUSD. No general email found. California SOS and SAM.gov not checked/found.

profile.summary: Hadar Institute is a New York City nonprofit that offers Jewish learning programs for adults, educators and communities. Its Pedagogy of Partnership program trains teachers in a partner-based learning method, using paired study to build students' communication and interpretation skills.

review.notes: hadar.org (Hadar Institute, 210 W 93rd St, New York, tel. (646) 770-1468) hosts Pedagogy of Partnership, which trains Jewish studies and general studies teachers; this matches the agenda name, New York location and teacher-training contract. The cited ProPublica record shows only 'Mechon Hadar' with no address, and no fetched page links that name or EIN to Hadar Institute, so legalName and ein are not confirmed.
